BiblicalUsage: Kibtsayim — Kibzaim in the text — is named once, in the list of cities given to the Kohathites out of Ephraim. A Levitical town with her suburbs, and nothing more is said.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a town named once in a list of Levite cities is kept in God's record, because no place his people dwelt is forgotten.
